review_description: Sale/quoting process was helpfully educational.  This was for a replacement of an old "home built" off grid solar system. VV Electrical and Solar  (Mit) assisted with different options, and the outcomes from these.  Capacity to upgrade later was an important consideration that was considered.  The installation went smoothly and took place over three consecutive days.  Two days for removal of old panels and installation of new panels, and a third day for the install and setup of the inverter and battery.  I can't fault Mit's commitment to a good result.  He says solar is his passion and it shows.  He was totally focused on a quality job.  Initial teething challenges with setup of the inverter were quickly addressed (Day 4), in spite of the more remote location of our property.  Mit stayed in touch over the holiday period, and even followed up when he was unable to reach the inverter to do a wifi check (while overseas) that all was well. I have no doubts about recommending VV Electrical and will continue with VV Electrical for further work into the future.
Very helpful and got things sorted easily. Quality job and great installer.
Service was excellent and installation a few weeks after initial contact - includes rebate approval (5 days). Best employees in many years.

What a team.  The installation went really well - extremely helpful, friendly and professional team...  Arrived on time and went straight to work.System working well, slight glitch with the data logger but confident that this will be resolved by this amazing team.Mit, from the start of the process, was extremely helpful, informative and patient as he took us through the process and the various options available.  I cannot fault him..

Admitedly the system is generating power against daily use [see above].NOTE: The supplier chosen was A] The only Australian to apply B] spoke proper English - not a Sub Continent variety and C] was geographically close by - not calling from QLD.
